svg.aria-label: Fabric and coherence, what the patents describe
svg.text: Fabric and coherence, what the patents describe
Most of this is patent reading (dotted). Only the QoS credits and the PIO network are inferred from measurements. Arrow weight is data; dashed is control.
A layered fabric, one port per cluster
per line: which L2 holds it
poison the line now, sync later
remote maintenance: one queue per cluster, refused until the core progresses
one request becomes the few commands a small cache understands
